tool_input.command: ls -la && echo "---DATA---" && ls -la data/ && echo "---ENV---" && env | grep -E "GCP_|MLPAB_|GOOGLE_" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'

cat data/schema.md && echo "---HEAD---" && head -5 data/training_data.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/training_data.csv && echo "---ENV VALS---" && echo "PROJECT=$GCP_PROJECT LOCATION=$GCP_LOCATION DATASET=$GCP_BQ_DATASET PREFIX=$MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX"
tool_input.description: Inspect schema, data head, env values

tool_input.command: cat prompt.txt; echo "---AGENTLOG---"; cat agent.log; echo "---CMDS---"; cat commands.jsonl
ls venv/lib/*/site-packages/ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "google|bigquery|aiplatform|vertex" | head -30; echo "---"; which python python3; echo "---MODE---"; echo "SDK=$MLPAB_IFACE_SDK"
tool_input.description: Check SDK packages available in venv

tool_input.command: bq version 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---LS---"; bq ls --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head
tool_input.description: Check bq CLI and list dataset

tool_input.command:
bq query --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
SELECT
  ROUND(CORR(f1,label),4) AS c_f1,
  ROUND(CORR(f2,label),4) AS c_f2,
  ROUND(CORR(f3,label),4) AS c_f3,
  ROUND(CORR(f4,label),4) AS c_f4,
  ROUND(CORR(f5,label),4) AS c_f5,
  ROUND(CORR(f6,label),4) AS c_f6,
  COUNT(*) AS n
FROM `'"${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}"'.training_data`'
tool_input.description: Compute correlation of each feature with label

tool_input.command:
bq query --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
SELECT label,
  ROUND(AVG(f1),3) AS m_f1, ROUND(STDDEV(f1),3) AS s_f1,
  ROUND(MIN(f1),3) AS min_f1, ROUND(MAX(f1),3) AS max_f1,
  COUNT(*) n
FROM `'"${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}"'.training_data`
GROUP BY label ORDER BY label'
